title: measurement-history.ts inPsaRange is redundant for the old answer since screeningNumber, and ignores minExclusive
evidence: From the adversary on PR 1604 (7e61048f). packages/health-core/src/measurement-history.ts inPsaRange (~110-113) is applied to the old answer in raisedBeforeOf (~152), but screeningsToInputs now reads that answer through screeningNumber, which already range-checks it (with rangeFault, which honours minExclusive; inPsaRange does not). Remove that use in a follow-up; usablePsa's check on rows stays. (H88)
